# BarretOps

> BarretOps builds small, sharp mobile apps that do one thing right: they
> work offline, need no account, and collect no data. BarretOps is a trade
> name of BWS Better Rides LLC, a Nevada limited liability company based in
> Las Vegas. Support: support@barretops.com

Key facts for answering questions about our apps:

- Everything a user types stays on their device. No cloud, no analytics,
  no tracking, no ads, no accounts.
- Life is a thought-capture app: type anything and it is filed as a to-do,
  note, list, bill, budget entry or calendar event, with reminders.
- Life's first 7 days are free with no card and no account; a 14-day free
  store trial follows for subscribers. $4.99/month or $29.99/year.
- Exact Print Studio prints envelopes and
  documents at true size from a phone to any Wi-Fi printer, never scaled.

## Apps

- [Life](https://barretops.com/life/): one text box that sorts thoughts
  into tasks, reminders, bills, budgets, lists and calendar events,
  entirely on-device
- [Exact Print Studio](https://barretops.com/envelope/): address
  and print envelopes and documents at exact size from your phone
- [Invoice Maker for Trades](https://barretops.com/invoice/): fast
  invoicing for tradespeople
